programs.notes: Valley View University publishes no aggregate cut-off; 36 is the C6 credit-pass minimum. Published programme rule (WASSCE): 'Compulsory Subjects - Grade C6 or better in three (3) core subjects (English, Mathematics, Integrated Science) and Elective Subjects - Grade C6 or better in three (3) elective subjects. The two electives should be science subjects. For Non-science students, elective mathematics is required.' Encoded as an elective_options pool of two science electives; the 'non-science students need Elective Mathematics' clause is not separately expressible.

Valley View University publishes no aggregate cut-off; 36 is the C6 credit-pass minimum. The two electives should be science subjects. For Non-science students, elective mathematics is required.' Encoded as an elective_options pool of two science electives; the 'non-science students need Elective Mathematics' clause is not separately expressible.

Valley View University publishes no aggregate cut-off; 36 is the C6 credit-pass minimum. Published programme rule (WASSCE): 'Grade C6 or better in three (3) core subjects (mathematics, integrated Science, and English) and Elective Subjects - Grade C6 or better in three (3) elective subjects in Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology or Mathematics) or General Arts, Home Economics and Agricultural Science.' The permitted elective set is so broad (science OR General Arts OR Home Economics OR Agricultural Science) that no mandatory elective or option pool can be recorded without inventing a restriction.

Valley View University publishes no aggregate cut-off. The published diploma bar is 'Six (6) Passes; (A1 - D7) in core subjects including English Language and Mathematics; and must possess a minimum of three (3) passes in elective subjects of which should be credit Passes (C6) or better.' The predictor cannot express a D7 core allowance (it hard-fails any D7 core), so this entry uses the stricter C6/aggregate-36 bar and will under-report eligibility for diploma applicants with D7 cores.

Valley View University publishes no aggregate cut-off; 36 is the C6 credit-pass minimum. Published rule for 'BSc Mathematics' (WASSCE): 'Grade C6 or better in three (3) core subjects (Mathematics, Integrated Science and English) and Elective Subjects - Grade C6 or better in three (3) elective subjects. The three elective subjects should include Elective Mathematics.' INFERRED: the site names 'BSc Mathematics' generically; VVU's only mathematics degrees are the two 'Mathematics with ...' variants, so the rule is applied to both.

Valley View University publishes no aggregate cut-off. The university-wide WASSCE bar is 'Credit Passes (A1-C6) in six (6) subjects comprising three core subjects, including English Language and Mathematics, plus three (3) relevant elective subjects' - an aggregate of 36. This is a minimum entry requirement, not a competitive cut-off. No elective is named for this programme, so none is recorded.
